items.description: A ring of dark Gerntar iron. Every calf of the Rustel herd is given one.

items.name: mine rat tail
items.description: The tail of a mine rat from the grass east of the Gerntar Mines.

items.name: ore beetle shell
items.description: The hard shell of an ore beetle from the rise south-east of the Gerntar Mines.

items.name: Gorespine's spine
items.description: A long black spine from the back of the young spineback Gorespine.

items.name: waking band
items.description: A band of tarnished bronze from the kings' stores. Each of the woken dead of the tomb wears one.

items.name: tomb beetle shell
items.description: The cracked shell of a tomb beetle from the excavators' pit in the Tomb of Kings.

items.name: crypt bat wing
items.description: The leathery wing of a crypt bat from the south passage of the Tomb of Kings.

items.name: stolen burial seal
items.description: A seal of old ivory, pried from a king's door by the robber Sela.

items.name: sprout's root sash
items.description: A sash of braided rootlets, still damp. Every sprout of the hall in Guk wears one.

items.name: cave beetle shell
items.description: The shell of a cave beetle from the north-east passage of the hall in Guk.

items.name: muck roach wing
items.description: The stiff wing of a muck roach from the east tunnel of the hall in Guk.

items.name: Old Manylegs' shell plate
items.description: A broad plate from the back of the great centipede Old Manylegs.
